verdict.rationale: Superset can clone a remote GitHub repository through its clone dialog and give each agent its own Git worktree and branch. Per the founder, it runs user-defined setup/teardown scripts per project that can install dependencies, transfer env variables, and start services. Workspaces can also be created programmatically via the MCP server, but cloning is a user action and environment setup comes from scripts the developer writes, not the agent configuring itself. missing for 10: evidence that the agent itself clones and bootstraps its environment autonomously, first-party docs for the setup-script mechanism (only a founder comment), hands-on corroboration of dependency install on workspace creation.
